indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Slipped about 36 points as tech gave back part of Monday's surge.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Fell about 356 points, dragged down by chip and AI stocks.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Rose about 423 points and closed above 50,000 for the first time.

notes: Chip stocks reversed after Monday's rally: Nvidia fell nearly 6%, Micron more than 11% after a downgrade, AMD more than 9%, and memory and storage names at least 5%.
HPE and Analog Devices each dropped about 17% despite strong revenue, on weaker margin outlooks and guidance; Anthropic closed below its $83 IPO price.

Money rotated into health care, retailers and industrials: Insmed jumped more than 14% on a roughly $41 billion Sanofi deal, Dick's and Kohl's rose about 15%, and consumer confidence came in well above forecasts.
events: Wed 25 Nov, 16:30 Kuwait time: October PCE inflation and the second estimate of Q3 GDP; the Fed's Beige Book follows at 22:00.
Thu 26 Nov: US markets closed for Thanksgiving; Fri 27 Nov closes early, at 21:00 Kuwait time.
